title: COMMAND YOUR DECEMBER TO DELIVER GOODNEWS
text: Glory to the name of Jesus. I want you to lift up your [music] hands wherever you are and begin to bless the name of the Lord. Begin to magnify his name. Begin to [music] worship him. For the Bible says in Psalm 34:1, "I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise shall continually be in my [music] mouth." Can I tell you something? The question is, are you postured to receive? Are you aligned [music] in the realm of the spirit to access what heaven has already prepared? You see, many believers [music] live their lives as spectators of their own destiny. They watch things happen to them instead [music] of commanding things to happen for them. They observe circumstances instead of legislating the supernatural. They react to situations [music] instead of creating atmospheres. But, I've come to tell you by the spirit of the living God that you were not created [music] to be a victim of December. You were created to be a victor in December. The spirit [music] of God says that there are dimensions of favor, there are realms of unprecedented [music] breakthrough, there are territories of supernatural acceleration that are locked up in [music] this month. And God is looking for a people who will not just pray passive prayers, but who will arise in the authority of the name of Jesus and begin to command their season [music] to align with the prophetic word of God over their lives. When I say command, I'm not talking about presumption. I'm not talking about arrogance. I'm talking about a believer [music] who understands spiritual authority. You see, authority is different from power. Power is the ability to do something, but authority is the legal [music] right to do it. And when Jesus gave you authority in Luke chapter 10:19, he said, "Behold, I [music] give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the [music] enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt you." This means that when you pray, you are not begging God. When you declare, you are not [music] hoping it might happen. You are enforcing what has already been decreed in the courts of heaven. I need you to understand something about the month of December. December is not just another month on the calendar. December carries prophetic weight. [music] This tells us that there is power in royal decree. When a king speaks, his word carries executive [music] authority. Let me break this down for you by the spirit of [music] God. To command means to give an authoritative order. It means to [music] speak with governmental weight. It means to legislate from your position of authority. You see, when Jesus walked on this earth, the Bible records several instances where he commanded situations and they obeyed him. In Mark chapter 4, when the storm was raging and the disciples were afraid, Jesus stood up and he said to the storm, "Peace. Be still." The Bible says the wind ceased and there was a great calm. Jesus didn't pray to [music] the Father about the storm. He didn't organize a prayer meeting. He didn't fast for [music] 3 days. And the Bible says the dead man sat up and began to speak. This is the dimension of authority that Jesus [music] demonstrated. And this is the same authority he has given to you. You see, in the realm of the spirit, there are forces that resist the will of God.
